name: TileLayer
doc: One map layer with stable identity, source cells and independent painter order.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: Stable layer identity (l_ground), used in field paths and cache keys.

fields.name: order
fields.doc: Draw order within the sorting layer.

fields.name: tint
fields.doc: Linear, straight-alpha tint applied to every tile, e.g. to darken backgrounds.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: Signed x,y keys to positive tile numbers; missing cells are empty.
